policy: A symbol the stock config does not contain is off in the candidate unless the tree needs it. Evidence per symbol: absent from the shipping kernel (no sdfat/knox/stlog/fslog/sqlite/PELT-16 code or symbol in its decoded kallsyms; shipping has fs/exfat only). Applied as explicit '# CONFIG_X is not set' lines before olddefconfig; the gate fails if olddefconfig turns any of them back on.

explicit_off.effect: reclaim treats anon and file pages equally (changes reclaim balance)
direct reclaim scans file pages only
raises the accepted vm.swappiness maximum to 200
PELT half-life 16 ms instead of 32 ms: different load_avg constants and tables, changes utilization seen by schedutil and EAS
adds Samsung Knox network-monitor objects to net/ and netfilter
adds a Samsung dlog hook in namei
storage-log calls in the eMMC path
storage-log in FAT (struct msdos_sb_info is private to fs/fat)
virtual xattr on FAT (also removes FAT_VIRTUAL_XATTR_SELINUX_LABEL)

removed_by_hook.how: delete_line 'source "fs/sdfat/Kconfig"' in fs/Kconfig (stock-board-hooks.json); SDFAT_FS is a hidden 'tristate default y' so no config line can turn it off
removed_by_hook.effect: drops the Samsung sdfat driver (registers 'sdfat'); exFAT comes from the Lenovo fs/exfat unit that the shipping kernel contains

neutral_constants.why: mm/filemap.c: '#if CONFIG_MMAP_READAROUND_LIMIT == 0 ra_pages = ra->ra_pages' i.e. no limit, same as mainline
mm/vmpressure.c: vmpressure_level_med = CONFIG_VMPRESSURE_LEVEL_MED; mainline value is 60

crc_layout_assessment: None of these symbols guards a type that an exported symbol's prototype can reach: fat.h is private to fs/fat, fslog.h and the ncm sources add declarations only, the rest are function bodies and constants in .c files. Static assessment only; the export-CRC gate against the shipping kernel is the check.
